seo_title: Sustainability Resources for IU Students | Net Impact IU
seo_description: Sustainability internships, scholarships, courses, job boards, certifications and clubs at Indiana University, collected by Net Impact IU.
headline: Resources for a career in sustainability
intro: Internships, funding, courses, job boards and clubs at Indiana University and beyond, collected by Net Impact IU for members and any IU student building a career in sustainability or social impact.

sections.title: Get hands-on experience
sections.intro: Internships and fellowships where you work on real sustainability projects while you are still in school.

items.name: Office of Sustainability internship
items.description: Paid, part-time campus internship ($15 an hour) on sustainability programs such as waste diversion, energy and move-out donations, or on sustainability communications.
items.timing: Applications have recently closed at the end of March.

items.name: McKinney Climate Fellows
items.description: Environmental Resilience Institute program placing students with Indiana local governments, businesses and nonprofits on climate and sustainability projects.
items.timing: Applications have typically closed in early November.

items.name: Kelley Institute for Social Impact internships
items.description: 120-hour internships applying business skills at social-impact organizations. Unpaid and not for credit.
items.audience: Kelley majors and minors after two semesters

items.name: Kelley Changemaker Internship Scholarship
items.description: Funding for students taking unpaid or underpaid social-impact internships with public, private or nonprofit organizations.

sections.title: Fund an idea or earn a scholarship
sections.intro: Money for sustainability projects on campus and for students starting sustainability research.

items.name: Campus Sustainability Innovation Fund
items.description: Office of Sustainability funding for projects that make IU Bloomington more sustainable.
items.timing: Applications have recently been due in late January.

items.name: Sustainability Scholars
items.description: Research a sustainability issue with a faculty mentor (8 to 10 hours a week) starting in your first semester, with a $500 scholarship each semester.
items.audience: First- and second-year students, any major
items.timing: Apply through IU Scholarships on One.IU.

sections.title: Study sustainability
sections.intro: Majors, co-majors and courses that build sustainability into an IU degree.

items.name: Sustainable Business co-major
items.description: Kelley co-major drawing on business, geography and public and environmental affairs courses to build sustainable business strategy skills.

items.name: Sustainability degrees and courses at IU
items.description: IU Bloomington's guide to sustainability degrees, minors and certificates across O'Neill, the College of Arts and Sciences, Kelley and more.

items.name: Kelley Institute for Environmental and Social Sustainability
items.description: Kelley's sustainability institute for research, courses, speakers and events on environmental and social sustainability in business.

sections.title: Find a job or internship
sections.intro: Job boards and networks focused on sustainability and impact careers.

items.name: Net Impact job board
items.description: Net Impact's national board of sustainability and social impact jobs and internships.

items.name: Indiana Sustainability Development Network
items.description: LinkedIn group for Indiana sustainability professionals that shares jobs, internships and events.

items.name: AASHE job board
items.description: Sustainability jobs at colleges and universities from the Association for the Advancement of Sustainability in Higher Education.

sections.more_text: See all sustainability job boards on IU's career resources page

sections.title: Earn a credential
sections.intro: Certifications that business students often pursue. Costs and exam requirements vary, so check each provider before you sign up.

items.name: LEED Green Associate
items.description: Entry-level green building credential from the U.S. Green Building Council, aimed at people newer to sustainability.

items.name: GRI Academy certification
items.description: Training and certification in corporate sustainability reporting with the Global Reporting Initiative Standards.

items.name: FSA Credential
items.description: IFRS Foundation credential in sustainability accounting and the SASB Standards, which link sustainability issues to financial performance.

items.name: CFA Institute Sustainable Investing Certificate
items.description: Certificate on working environmental, social and governance factors into investment analysis and decisions.

sections.more_text: See all certifications on IU's career resources page

sections.title: Stay connected
sections.intro: Newsletters, events and volunteer opportunities on campus and in Bloomington.

items.name: Office of Sustainability newsletter and events
items.description: Campus sustainability news, events, internships and funding deadlines from IU's Office of Sustainability.

items.name: Environmental Resilience Institute
items.description: IU's climate and environmental research institute, home of IU Climate Week and the McKinney Climate Fellows, with newsletters and events.

items.name: Bloomington Volunteer Network
items.description: The City of Bloomington's volunteer site, with hundreds of one-time and recurring opportunities with local nonprofits, including environmental projects.

sections.title: Related clubs at IU
sections.intro: Other student organizations working on sustainability and social impact. Many members join more than one.

items.name: Sustainable Finance Club
items.description: Real-world cases and industry engagement on finance's role in environmental and social impact.

items.name: 180 Degrees Consulting
items.description: Student-run consultancy serving nonprofits and social enterprises.

items.name: Social Engagement and Education at Kelley (SEEK)
items.description: Applies business skills where for-profit enterprise meets social responsibility.

items.name: Alternative Break Program
items.description: Service-learning trips over Thanksgiving, winter and spring breaks.

items.name: Epsilon Eta
items.description: IU's environmental fraternity: gender-inclusive and pre-professional.

items.name: Sigma Epsilon Beta
items.description: Career education and applied learning in sustainability, corporate advocacy and entrepreneurship.

items.name: Rewild at IU
items.description: Restores and manages IU's natural areas with students, faculty and local environmental groups.

items.name: Women in Conservation
items.description: Academic and professional development for women in conservation, plus hands-on conservation work.

items.name: Students for the New Urbanism at IU
items.description: Students learning about and advocating for better cities and towns.

items.name: Habitat for Humanity at IU
items.description: Building, fundraising and advocacy events with the Monroe County Habitat chapter.
